title: Voice Roundels & Spatial Grab · v0.9.2
changes: Replaced clipped HEARD notification with yellow speech text outlined in black, with transparent adaptive canvas and no fixed background.
Added left microphone, centre camera eye and conditional right Extract roundels within the XR space.
Dictation records up to 12 seconds; text waits for visible OK/Cancel controls, with no automatic keyboard launch.
Pinned bottom toolbar now retains its world orientation rather than rotating with the viewer.
Images remain attached to the original target-ray grab transform, including full 3D rotation and initial hand-to-card offset.
Image generation and Restore show animated orbiting particles around the selected source/object card.
Disabled duplicate paid actions while inference is in progress and preserved existing profiles, quota and encrypted keys.
